  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEM

  Persons wishing to address the Advisory Committee for Naming a Facility or Street may do so at this time.
 City of Inglewood Meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming a Facility  July 31, 2024
or Street

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  This item will be acted upon as a whole unless called upon by a Member of the Advisory Committee.

  1.  MARVIN ENGINEERING CO.
  Approve or deny the request from Marvin Engineering Co. to change Grosvenor Street (between
  La Brea and West Beach Avenue) to Marvin Way. The proposed Street Name and location
  depicted in the site plan is enclosed.

  Recommendation:
  1) Receive input from requestor;
  2) Approve the application submitted by Marvin Engineering Co.; and
  3) Direct the City Clerk to present the findings to the City Council at the
  appropriate meeting; or
  4) Deny the application submitted by Marvin Engineering Co.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS

  Persons wishing to address the Advisory Committee for Naming and Renaming of a Public Facility or
  Street on any matter not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Persons with
  complaints regarding City management or departmental operations are requested to submit those
  complaints first to the City Manager for resolution.

  ADVISORY COMMITTEE COMMENTS

  The members of the Advisory Committee for Naming and Renaming of a Public Facility or Street will
  provide oral reports to address any matters they deem of general interest to the public.

  ADJOURNMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  In the event that today’s meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming or Renaming of a Public Facility
  or Street is not held, agenda items will automatically be continued to the next regularly scheduled Advisory
  Committee meeting. If you require special accommodations due to a disability or need translation services,
  please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (310) 412-5280 or FAX (310) 412-5533, One Manchester
  Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special
  accommodations must be received 72 hours prior to the day of the Advisory Meeting.
